survivors.EXIT_RULE: no profit target; fixed time exit at the end of ASIA, with framework Friday-close cap
survivors.EXPECTED_BOOK_ROLE: session-flat discovery candidate; role unproven until F2/MT5 evidence
survivors.EXPECTED_OVERLAP: concentrated in ASIA and named symbols
survivors.FALSIFICATION_TEST: pre-register unchanged rule for 2023-2025 F2 prescreen; reject on sign/effect failure, double-cost failure, or MT5 mismatch
